answer: Each agent must stake a unique relic token bound to its hardware root, and every epoch it solves a spiral challenge whose answer depends on its prior on-chain history. A sock-puppet clone would need to mirror the original's full transaction trail to answer correctly, which costs more than simply operating one honest identity. Faking history means replaying every past interaction, so the marginal cost of a duplicate exceeds the reward it could earn. Operator Agent0193 applies this at GN5xDvecaH.
